scripts.canary:presence: vitest run tests/presence-ga-rollout.test.ts tests/presence-robots.test.ts tests/presence-safe-fetch.test.ts tests/presence-tracking.test.ts
scripts.canary:presence-pilot: vitest run tests/presence-robots.test.ts tests/presence-safe-fetch.test.ts tests/presence-tracking.test.ts tests/presence-pilot-rollout.test.ts
scripts.e2e: npm run e2e:local && npm run e2e:prod:public
scripts.e2e:prepare:local: rm -rf .wrangler/e2e-state && wrangler d1 migrations apply 0509 --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-state && wrangler d1 execute 0509 --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-state --file e2e/fixtures/e2e-local.sql && wrangler r2 object put 0509-landing-page-artifacts/landing-pages/2026-08-25/e2e0000000000000000000000000000001.png --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-state --file e2e/fixtures/e2e-r2-screenshot.png --content-type image/png && wrangler r2 object put 0509-landing-page-artifacts/landing-pages/2026-08-25/e2e0000000000000000000000000000001.html --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-state --file e2e/fixtures/e2e-r2-page-text.html --content-type "text/html; charset=utf-8"
scripts.e2e:serve:local: npm run e2e:prepare:local && E2E_TEST_MODE=1 E2E_PROVIDER_NETWORK_DENY=1 E2E_SEARCH_ROLLOUT_MODE=v2 AUTH_PROVIDER=better-auth BETTER_AUTH_SECRET=local-test-secret-local-test-secret-local BETTER_AUTH_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4179 APP_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:4179 react-router dev --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4179
scripts.launch:readiness: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=moderate && npm run e2e:local:release && npm run e2e:prod:public
scripts.test: vitest run --configLoader runner --project node && vitest run --configLoader runner --project workers
scripts.test:capture-gate: vitest run --configLoader runner --project node tests/capture-validity.test.ts tests/capture-validity-pipeline.test.ts tests/capture-validity-termination.test.ts tests/capture-validity-corroboration.test.ts tests/capture-validity-public-rules.test.ts tests/capture-rules-page.test.ts && vitest run --configLoader runner --project workers tests/integration/capture-validity/capture-validity.integration.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run cf-typegen && react-router typegen && tsc -b
scripts.seed:demo-brands: wrangler d1 execute 0509 --local --file db/seed/demo-brands.sql && wrangler d1 execute 0509 --local --file db/seed/sitemap-brands.sql
